messages:
support_eli: Hey team — customer Zephyr (acct_zephyr) opened a support ticket: their nightly embeddings job started getting 429s midway through. Job id `emb-job-2026-03-14-99`. They sent a heap of small docs in parallel and got a steady stream of 429s. Pasted error: ```json
{
  "error": "Rate limit exceeded",
  "status": 429,
  "reason": "burst_quota_exceeded",
  "endpoint": "/v1/embeddings"
}
```

customer_zephyr: we kicked off ~120k docs over ~20m with 40 workers, batch_size=512. After a few minutes the client started getting 429s and we retried aggressively which made it worse. Also saw some weird dimension errors after retries: "expected 1536 got 1024". Any quick fixes?

samantha: thanks for the details. a couple of immediate suspects: (1) burst limiter per-account tripped, (2) retries without jitter amplified the burst, (3) fallback to a lower-dim model produced the dimension mismatch when the client retried against the fallback.

dmitri-ml: can you confirm model name and SDK version? dimension mismatch usually means the model serving the request changed (fallback or model alias pointing to variant).

customer_zephyr: model was `embed-large-v1` (1536-dim). SDK v1.2.0. Their client code does naive retries: sleep 100ms and retry up to 5x. Concurrency=40, batch_size=512.

support_eli: that config will easily create spikes. batch_size 512 x 40 concurrent requests -> large instantaneous token throughput. our burst quota is designed to smooth this. immediate retries will requeue bursts. also if autoscaling can't spin up extra capacity, we trigger burst_quota_exceeded and start returning 429s.

dmitri-ml: repro plan: I'll run a scaled-down workload from staging key to reproduce: 5k docs, concurrency 20, batch 512, naive retry. will collect edge logs and observe 429 rate.

infra-bot: INF-2031 created for per-account temporary quota review, assigned to @rachel-infra.

support_eli: customer asked if we can temporarily raise their burst for the job window. short-term we can consider a limited lift with cost guardrails. long-term recommend reserved/dedicated throughput for such bulk runs.

customer_zephyr: we'd prefer a short lift while we rework the client. what's safe?

rachel-infra (via infra-bot): can grant a timeboxed 2x burst lift for up to 2 hours for safety review. need approval from finance for free-tier accounts.

support_eli: in parallel, please add these recommended mitigations on your side: reduce concurrency to ~8-12 workers, lower batch_size to 128-256, add jittered exponential backoff (do not retry immediately), detect model dimension on init and fail fast if mismatch after a fallback. example backoff snippet we suggested: ```js
function backoffMs(attempt){
  const base = 200; // ms
  return Math.min(10000, Math.pow(2, attempt)*base + Math.floor(Math.random()*200));
}
// on 429: await sleep(backoffMs(attempt));
```

dmitri-ml: ran the staging run: with concurrency 20 and batch 512 we saw ~45% 429s after ~90s. switching to batch 256 and concurrency 10 dropped 429s to <2% and avg latency per call decreased. logs: ```
2026-03-14T22:10:02Z POST /v1/embeddings 429 burst_quota_exceeded acct=acct_zephyr
2026-03-14T22:10:03Z POST /v1/embeddings 200 latency=310ms
2026-03-14T22:10:15Z POST /v1/embeddings 429 burst_quota_exceeded
```

customer_zephyr: we'll throttle down and add jittered backoff, can you enable a temporary lift while we validate? we'd like a 90-minute window.

rachel-infra: approved 90-minute 2x burst lift starting 2026-03-15T02:00Z. conditions: monitor token usage, auto-revoke if cost > $400 in the window. INF-2031 will track.

support_eli: shipping checklist for this ticket: (1) apply timeboxed burst lift, (2) confirm customer implements backoff + reduces concurrency, (3) monitor edge 429s and cost, (4) follow up on dimension mismatch possibility.

dmitri-ml: about the dimension errors — we saw a client-side flow where on a 429 the client retried against a fallback alias which pointed to `embed-small` (1024-dim). Because the client batches outputs into a single matrix, when one batch contained mixed dims a postprocessing reshape failed. Mitigation: verify model dim before consuming a batch and reject mixed-dim batches. Also server can send `x-model-dim` header on response to help clients detect this mismatch. will open ENG-4573 to add header.

docs_liaison: noted — will add an embeddings best-practices page with recommended defaults (batch_size <=256, concurrency <=12 for large jobs, required jittered backoff sample code, how to detect model dim changes).

customer_zephyr: thanks — we've deployed the client change (concurrency 10, batch 256, jittered backoff) and will run a dry-run during the 2x burst window. we'll post results in ~20m. appreciate the fast turnaround :thumbsup:

support_eli: closing the thread once you confirm the dry-run. follow-ups: ENG-4573 (x-model-dim header), INF-2031 (burst lift), DOCS ticket for embedding defaults. Thanks all. :pray:
